title: Transcriptome Analysis of Insulin Signaling-Associated Transcription Factors in C. elegans Reveal Their Genome-Wide Target Genes Specificity and Complexity.
authors: Kaushik, Neha; Rastogi, Soumya; Verma, Sonia; Pandey, Deepak; Halder, Ashutosh; Mukhopadhyay, Arnab; Kumar, Neeraj
one_liner_zh: 该文通过RNA-seq分析线虫胰岛素信号相关转录因子DAF-16、SKN-1和HSF-1的靶基因特异性与调控网络，属于转录因子-基因表达调控研究，但缺乏蛋白质-DNA三维互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅涉及转录组层面的靶基因鉴定。
abstract: Insulin/IGF-1-like signaling (IIS) plays a crucial, conserved role in development, growth, reproduction, stress tolerance, and longevity. In Caenorhabditis elegans, the enhanced longevity under reduced insulin signaling (rIIS) is primarily regulated by the transcription factors (TFs) DAF-16/FOXO, SKN-1/Nrf-1, and HSF1/HSF-1. The specific and coordinated regulation of gene expression by these TFs under rIIS has not been comprehensively elucidated. Here, using RNA-sequencing analysis, we report a systematic study of the complexity of TF-dependent target gene interactions during rIIS under analogous genetic and experimental conditions. We found that DAF-16 regulates only a fraction of the C. elegans transcriptome but controls a large set of genes under rIIS; SKN-1 and HSF-1 show the opposite trend. Both of the latter TFs function as activators and repressors to a similar extent, while DAF-16 is predominantly an activator. For expression of the genes commonly regulated by TFs under rIIS conditions, DAF-16 is the principal determining factor, dominating over the other two TFs, irrespective of whether they activate or repress these genes. The functional annotations and regulatory networks presented in this study provide novel insights into the complexity of the gene regulatory networks downstream of the IIS pathway that controls diverse phenotypes, including longevity.
abstract_zh: 胰岛素/IGF-1样信号传导（IIS）在发育、生长、繁殖、应激耐受及寿命中发挥着关键且保守的作用。在秀丽隐杆线虫（Caenorhabditis elegans）中，胰岛素信号减弱（rIIS）条件下增强的寿命主要由转录因子（TFs）DAF-16/FOXO、SKN-1/Nrf-1和HSF1/HSF-1调控。在rIIS条件下，这些转录因子对基因表达的特异性及协调调控尚未被全面阐明。本研究利用RNA测序分析，在相似的遗传和实验条件下，系统研究了rIIS期间TF依赖性靶基因相互作用的复杂性。我们发现，DAF-16仅调控线虫转录组的一小部分，但在rIIS条件下控制了大量基因；而SKN-1和HSF-1则呈现相反趋势。后两种转录因子在激活和抑制功能上程度相似，而DAF-16主要作为激活因子。对于rIIS条件下由转录因子共同调控的基因表达，DAF-16是主要决定因素，其作用超过其他两种转录因子，无论它们是激活还是抑制这些基因。本研究所呈现的功能注释和调控网络为IIS通路下游控制多种表型（包括寿命）的基因调控网络复杂性提供了新见解。
